headline: Fire breaks out at Chawkbazar market, 5 units responding
summary: Firefighters are battling a blaze at the busy Chawkbazar market in Dhaka, with multiple units deployed to contain the fire.
details: A fire has broken out at the Chawkbazar market in Dhaka, causing panic among local traders and residents.
Five units of the Fire Service and Civil Defence are working to bring the blaze under control.
The cause of the fire has not yet been determined, and officials are monitoring the situation closely.
Emergency services are on-site to prevent the fire from spreading to adjacent buildings in the densely populated area.

topic: two retired army officers arrested over alleged anti-state conspiracy
headline_marked: Two retired army officers [[remanded over alleged plot to destabilise Bangladesh]]
headline: Two retired army officers remanded over alleged plot to destabilise Bangladesh
summary: Lt (retd) Kazi Gulshan Ara and Lt Col (retd) Debashish Kumar Barua face four-day remand in a sedition case involving anti-state activities.
details: A Dhaka court has placed two retired army officers, Lt (retd) Kazi Gulshan Ara and Lt Col (retd) Debashish Kumar Barua, on a four-day remand in a sedition case.
The Detective Branch (DB) of Dhaka Metropolitan Police produced the officers before the court after they were arrested in separate drives in Pallabi and Banani DOHS.
According to the forwarding report, the accused are alleged to have collected funds for anti-government activities and disseminated provocative content on social media to incite violence.
The report further alleges that they maintained contact with former army chief General (retd) Aziz Ahmed and fugitive leaders of the banned Awami League to conspire against the state.
Investigators claim the accused were involved in terrorist activities and provided illegal funding to a banned organisation through platforms like 'Unity Care' and 'Public Parliament'.
The two officers are also accused of forming the 'Bangabandhu Sena Parishad' to spread hatred among social groups and incite riots and clashes.
Additionally, the report states that they used social media and talk shows to spread contempt for the government and have links to domestic and foreign spies.
The case was filed at Pallabi Police Station under the Penal Code, the Anti-Terrorism Act, and the Cyber Security Ordinance, naming 101 other unnamed accused.
caption:
Two retired army officers are in custody for an alleged conspiracy to destabilise the country.

A Dhaka court has placed two retired army officers, Lt (retd) Kazi Gulshan Ara and Lt Col (retd) Debashish Kumar Barua, on a four-day remand in a sedition case.

The Detective Branch (DB) of Dhaka Metropolitan Police produced the officers before the court after they were arrested in separate drives in Pallabi and Banani DOHS.

According to the forwarding report, the accused are alleged to have collected funds for anti-government activities and disseminated provocative content on social media to incite violence.

The report further alleges that they maintained contact with former army chief General (retd) Aziz Ahmed and fugitive leaders of the banned Awami League to conspire against the state.

Investigators claim the accused were involved in terrorist activities and provided illegal funding to a banned organisation through platforms like 'Unity Care' and 'Public Parliament'.

The two officers are also accused of forming the 'Bangabandhu Sena Parishad' to spread hatred among social groups and incite riots and clashes.

Additionally, the report states that they used social media and talk shows to spread contempt for the government and have links to domestic and foreign spies.

The case was filed at Pallabi Police Station under the Penal Code, the Anti-Terrorism Act, and the Cyber Security Ordinance, naming 101 other unnamed accused.
